text:
incident-bot: ALERT: increase in 502/504 errors observed at api-gateway-edge. 1m error rate ~18%, p95 latency up. Paging oncall-sre and edge team.

sara (oncall-sre): seeing it, pulling up dashboards now. which regions affected?

devon (edge-eng): us-east-1 and eu-west-1 hit first, but logs show requests failing at gateway -> upstream timeouts. possible upstream flapping.

alisha (infra): rolling metrics show a sudden spike right after the 15:20 deploy (deploy-PR#3421). but correlation not confirmed.

mike (api-pm): customers start reporting timeouts on embeddings endpoint. any mitigation we can do quickly to reduce customer impact?

sara (oncall-sre): immediate mitigations I can try: 1) divert traffic from overloaded edge pool to backup pool, 2) increase gateway upstream timeout from 2s -> 5s temporarily, 3) disable canary routing for deploy-PR#3421. trying divert first.

devon (edge-eng): I can take a look at the edge proxy pools. running command to mark pool-07 as drain: 
```
# mark pool-07 drain
edgectl pool set-state --pool pool-07 --state DRAINING --region us-east-1
```

alisha (infra): scaling backend upstreams now (kubectl scale deployment api-upstream --replicas=10 -n pi-prod). also reverting recent rate-limiter tweak that lowered concurrency.

sara (oncall-sre): applied temporary gateway timeout bump in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. monitoring.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty escalation to SRE lead at +5 minutes if error rate >15%.

devon (edge-eng): pool drain acknowledged. traffic shifting away from pool-07; we should see reduced 502s in a minute.

sara (oncall-sre): error rate dropping to ~7% in us-east-1 after drain and upstream scale. eu-west still elevated 10-12%.

mike (api-pm): thanks — customer impact: multiple mid-market customers reported intermittent failures for ~10 mins, a couple of 500s in logs. flagging for CS.

alisha (infra): found a series of upstream 504s pointing to node oom/killed events at 15:21-15:25. looks like the autoscaler didn't kick fast enough for this load pattern.

sara (oncall-sre): taking ownership. devon continue edge rollback/checks, alisha focus on autoscaler/hpa immediate adjustments. mike coordinate customer comms. I'll update status page.

devon (edge-eng): investigating why pool-07 overloaded — initial suspicion: a misrouted high-rt request class. checking access logs.

sara (oncall-sre): quick checklist so we have an audit trail: 
- action: drain pool-07 (devon)
- action: bump gateway timeout to 5s (sara)
- action: scale api-upstream to 10 replicas (alisha)
- action: revert rate-limiter change (alisha)
- action: open support ticket for customers (mike)

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigation in progress. current global error rate: 6.3% (5m).

mike (api-pm): CS notified, draft sent saying we’re investigating an elevated error rate, some 502/504s, mitigations applied. will send update at +30.

devon (edge-eng): found anomalous client that sent long-lived requests causing backend queue backlog. blocking that client at edge now: 
```
edgectl block-client --id 44f3a2 --reason "excessive long-lived requests" --region eu-west-1
```

alisha (infra): autoscaler tuned to be more aggressive for 5m spike windows. monitoring for flapping.

sara (oncall-sre): handoff: I need to switch to another incident. alisha, devon — I'm handing this to you both. alisha will be primary oncall for infra; devon primary for edge. tag me if anything regresses.

devon (edge-eng): acked, taking lead on edge side. will keep logs and diffs.

alisha (infra): acked, will continue with autoscaler and check kernel OOM kill traces on affected nodes.

pagerduty: Escalation suppressed — owner acknowledged.

sara (oncall-sre): summary for post-incident: spike in long-lived client requests + insufficient autoscaler aggressiveness -> upstream saturation -> gateway 502/504 spikes. mitigations: traffic drain, backend scale, timeout bump, client block, revert rate-limiter. impact: partial customer-facing errors for ~10-20m. postmortem owner: devon (edge-eng) and alisha (infra) with help from mike for customer timeline.

mike (api-pm): I’ll collect affected customer list and delivery window for updates.

devon (edge-eng): will start a dedicated incident doc and include timeline, logs, and exact commands used. assigning postmortem deadline EOD +3.

alisha (infra): leaving notes for oncall rotation: monitor autoscaler logs and unhealthy node counts in the next 24h.

sara (oncall-sre): thanks team — closing my active oncall handoff. I’ll monitor the status page until full resolution confirmed.

devon (edge-eng): final check: error rate down to 1.8% globally, p95 latency normalized. continuing monitoring.

alisha (infra): last: captured heap profiles and OOM logs, attaching to incident doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigations successful). please file postmortem per runbook.

devon (edge-eng): closing thread here; follow-up in incident-doc-1898765432 in Confluence.
